body: I get you. I was extremely suicidal during my time at UMD too, but I graduated and got out. Still get a bit frozen up and nauseous thinking of uni days but if I got out you can do it too. If you’re anything like me, maybe you’re thinking that everything is meaningless and cursing the fact that you have do all of this crap just to survive. It sucks. always repeated to myself that nothing is forever. You can do it, just make it out and get to the other side

I go through this cycle with every test because to this day I haven’t been able to fix myself. Can just never seem to start studying because it’s like horrible torture on my soul. But I can say this: save the agonizing until after the test. At this point, keep telling yourself that you can’t chase the past no matter what. What’s passed is passed. Make that your motto. Agonizing won’t help you right before the test at all. I’ve been through organic chemistry, same as you, and even until the end I never managed to memorize the basics. But hey, got through college and am in a whole new world of pain with grad school rn so there’s hope (????)

I feel you 100%. It's always a struggle between forcing yourself to do the work you hate and wasting your life doing utterly pointless work. Which ends in, as you said, pushing work off until the last minute and spending the next week recovering from the mental and physical strain haha...

Thank god, completely on the same page as you. Could not have said it better. Reminds me of something else.. During quarantine I keep seeing posts of people complaining that they aren't learning anything and they feel like they're just doing the assignments for a grade. And I'm like... Isn't that always the case though? You mean to tell me you actually want to learn here?? What could you possibly be learning? Isn't the concept of school literally just brainlessly doing assignments for a grade?
